sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring orders, CAC, medical/dental records, birth/marriage certificates, and all travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing
sections.body: Report to 902 ABW in-processing upon arrival. Coordinate with your gaining unit and sponsor. MPF appointment required within 5 duty days.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact housing at 210-652-1840 before departure. Temporary lodging available at Randolph Gateway Inn (210-652-1031). Privatized family housing managed by Hunt Companies.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Contact your gaining unit to confirm sponsor assignment before departure. Sponsors assist with base orientation, housing, and in-processing.
